title: After the Debut: Whoa, For Real?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer makes it through her debut, but she wasn't able to run it the way she wanted—like it was a party.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To run freely, she must first free her mind. To that end, we set her a goal of getting 9,000 like-minded fans who are down to party.
